From: Elaine Park <elaine@cartly.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T09:02:00-05:00
Subject: Quick demo request — Cart search embeddings

Hi Sofia,

I signed up for Redwood's self-serve yesterday and started running a few embedding calls against a small product index. We're seeing promising results but want to understand production costs and latency at higher QPS before committing to a pilot.

High-level details:
- Use case: semantic search + recommendations for product pages
- Current sample traffic: ~250 reqs/min to embeddings endpoint (p50 90ms on our side), expected ramp to 1200 reqs/min over 6 weeks if trial goes well
- Desired latency: user-facing <150ms per query
- Timeline: want a pilot started in Jan to validate cost/opportunity for Q1 roadmap

I can share a small export of recent traffic patterns (attached). Would love a quick 20–30m walkthrough focused on which model/throughput plan makes sense and any recommended batching/caching approaches.

Also copying Carlos (FastMart) who helped with our infra planning — he may join the demo.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Search — Cartly
attachments: traffic_export.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T10:17:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — Cart search embeddings

Hi Elaine — thanks for the details and the export. I work with Sofia on inbound trials; happy to run the walkthrough. Before we lock a slot, a few quick qualification items so we tailor the session: 

1) Traffic shape: is the ~1200 reqs/min steady-state or bursty (e.g., peak 6 hours/day)?
2) Payloads: average tokens/input for embeddings and whether you plan to embed full product descriptions or only vectors for titles + facets.
3) Auth & data: will queries contain PII, and do you need Private deployment or is hosted acceptable for the pilot?
4) Success metrics: cost per MAU? end-to-end latency budget including your app vs. our inference time?

If you prefer, we can do a short call to go through these and then demo a recommended config (model, batch size, prefix cache). I have availability tomorrow 11:00–11:30am ET, and 3:30–4:00pm ET. Sofia — if one of those works for you I can send a calendar invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quick demo request — Cart search embeddings

Thanks Ben. Quick answers: 
1) Shape: mostly steady with two hourly peaks around checkout windows — peaks add ~30% above baseline for ~2 hours/day. Baseline expected to ramp as we add more products.
2) Payloads: average 120 tokens per request (title + short description + category tokens). We'll probably move to title+facets in pilot to reduce cost if needed.
3) No PII in query text; hosted is fine for the pilot but we may require VPC + KMS for production.
4) Success metrics: keep incremental cost < $0.10 per successful product recommendation; p95 inference time <250ms end-to-end.

Attached is a 48-hour slice of traffic and a quick product deck (cartly-quick-intake.pdf). Tomorrow 11:00–11:30am ET works for me; Carlos will likely join the call at 11:10.
